logic.entry: On completed UTC daily barj, compute Decimal median of the lastL closed daily closes includingj; evenL averages the middle two. When flat, enter iff close[j]>median*(1+entry_hurdle_fraction), strict inequality.
logic.exit: When long, exit iff close[j]<median*(1-entry_hurdle_fraction), strict inequality. Equality/deadband preserves held/cash state. Only completed closes enter the median; no pending future data.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.citation: Python3.12 statistics.median documentation: middle value, average of two middle values for an even window; Decimal supported.
sources.scope: Mathematical definition only, not profitability evidence.
